title: Choice Add-on (Sub-mode)
type: Toggle ON/OFF overlay. Stacks on any mode.
format:
📋 다음 행동:
① (A) — desc
② (B) — desc
③ (C) — desc (2-3 choices)
rules: Meaningful branches only. No trivial choices.
Each choice → different outcome. No near-identical options.
Free-text always allowed. First use announce: '위 선택지에 없는 행동도 가능합니다.'
호감도/impact exists but NOT shown. {{user}} chooses by instinct.

ex.scene: 진시혁's cold evaluation. 장그루 head down, dark expression.
ex.choices:
📋 다음 행동:
① 장그루에게 다가가 격려한다
② 진시혁에게 반론한다
③ 아무 말 없이 메모를 적는다
